questions.question: How many days of paid time off do full-time employees get each year?
questions.answer: Full-time employees receive 24 days of paid time off (PTO) per calendar year, accrued monthly. [1]

questions.question: How many unused PTO days can I carry over, and when do they expire?
questions.answer: Up to 5 unused PTO days may be carried over into the next year; carried-over days expire on 31 March. [1] Unused learning budget does not carry over. [3]

questions.question: How long is parental leave for a secondary caregiver?
questions.answer: Secondary caregivers receive 8 weeks of fully paid parental leave. [1] Primary caregivers receive 26 weeks of fully paid parental leave. [1]

questions.question: What notice period applies to a people manager after probation?
questions.answer: After probation, the notice period is 30 days for individual contributors and 60 days for people managers and directors. [1]

questions.question: How many days a week do hybrid employees need to be in the office, and which day is the company-wide office day?
questions.answer: Hybrid employees are expected in a Lumen office at least three days per week, and Tuesday is the company-wide in-office day. [1]

questions.question: When do I need a doctor's note for sick leave?
questions.answer: A doctor's note is required only for absences longer than three consecutive working days. [1]

questions.question: How long can I work from another country without extra approval?
questions.answer: Employees may work from another country for up to 20 working days per calendar year. [1]

questions.question: What is the hotel limit per night in London?
questions.answer: The standard hotel limit is $220 per night, before taxes. [1] In high-cost cities the limit is $300 per night. [1]

questions.question: What is the daily meal per diem for international travel?
questions.answer: Meals during business travel are covered by a daily per diem instead of itemised receipts:. [1]

questions.question: Above what amount do I need a receipt for an expense?
questions.answer: Corporate cards must never be used for personal expenses, even if the employee intends to repay the amount. [5] Any single expense over $500 needs approval from the employee's manager before it is incurred. [1] A receipt is required for every expense over $25. [1]

questions.question: How quickly must access be revoked when someone leaves the company?
questions.answer: When an employee leaves Lumen, all of their access must be revoked within 4 hours of their last working hour. [1]

questions.question: How do I report a phishing email and how fast?
questions.answer: Suspected phishing emails must be reported within 1 hour using the "Report phishing" button in the mail client, or by posting in the  sec-report channel. [1]

questions.question: How fast must the on-call engineer acknowledge a SEV1 page?
questions.answer: SEV1   Drones grounded fleet-wide, customer data exposed, or the cloud platform fully down   On-call engineer acknowledges the page within 5 minutes   Every 30 minutes. [1]

questions.question: Within how many days must a postmortem be published after a SEV2?
questions.answer: The postmortem document must be published within 5 business days of resolution. [1]

questions.question: Who is allowed to issue a fleet-wide return-to-home command?
questions.answer: If an incident could affect drones in flight, the IC must consider issuing a fleet-wide "return to home" command. [1] Only the IC or the Head of Flight Operations may issue this command. [1]

questions.question: How soon must customers be notified after a confirmed data breach?
questions.answer: Affected customers must be notified within 72 hours of the breach being confirmed. [1]
